title: Static High-Shoulder Knuckle-Grounded Gorilla
description: One complete newly authored static gorilla-like ape in a low four-contact display pose. A broad high shoulder/back mass narrows toward a lower rear pelvis; its short thick forward neck and low heavy-browed head are continuous with the torso. Two very long muscular bent forearms end in broad thick grounded knuckle-like hand masses while two much shorter flexed rear legs end in forward finite feet. A broad flat nose, small forward eyes, thick brow and two small low ears distinguish the face; no tail or branch. All whole body/limb/face sections and positions newly authored, not a plush bear stretched or the hanging sloth reposed. One static stylised model, zero scenes; no exact species, detailed finger anatomy, real gait/load-bearing, aggression, rig, animation or biological claim.
